name: ministral-3-14b
about: Mistral AI Ministral 3 14B Instruct (2512), dense, FP8 as published by Mistral. Apache-2.0, EU vendor. Loaded in Mistral's own format as its model card prescribes for vLLM, at temperature 0.05: the card asks for below 0.1 in production. Served with vLLM v0.29.0: v0.30.0 ships transformers 5.17, which renamed a class vLLM's Pixtral code imports, so every Mistral 3 model fails to start there (vllm-project/vllm#58755, fixed on main, no 0.30 patch release). Sends reasoning_effort "none": the app's "low" (a gpt-oss setting) is refused by Mistral models, which accept only none or high (found by the app-shape probe, 2026-09-26). FP8 weights: it failed to compile on an A40 (Ampere, no native FP8); prefer an Ada, Hopper or Blackwell card.
